Claim 1 (Currently Amended): A compound of formula (IIa) O NaO OR2 0 (II a), in which substituent R2 is selected from the group consisting of C1-C12-alkyl, C6-aryl, and arylalkyl, wherein the compound exhibits unique properties compared to those of corresponding potassium salts.

Claim 2 (Currently Amended): A compound according to Claim 1 of formula (II a) in which R2 is C1-C12-alkyl, C6-aryl, or arylalkyl, wherein said C1-C12-alkyl is not ethyl.

Claim 3 (Original): A compound according to Claim 1 of formula (II a) in which R2 is methyl or ethyl.  
Claim 4 (Original): A compound of formula (Ilb) O ZO OMe O O (I Ib) in which substituent Z is selected from the group consisting of alkali metals and alkaline earth metals.  
Claim 5 (Original): A compound according to Claim 1 of formula (Il b) in which Z is sodium or potassium.
